variants.about: Invented. VAR01-VAR05 share one layout (headings Parties, Judgment, Service, Counsel, Garnishee), so a template learned from them matches the rest: the matches and suggested cases. VAR06 puts the caption in two columns and VAR07 continues onto page 2; no template of VAR01's layout matches either: the unknown case. Each carries an amount, a date served and a response deadline, which the photographed set lacks.
